messages:
opsbot: Pager triggered: generation-latency-apac (gen-queue-throttle). Severity: P1. Incident ID: INC-2026-0423-A.
rowan: I'm oncall. seeing elevated 5xx on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings in apac-west-1. marking as partial degradation for APAC region. starting statuspage copy draft.
emma: I'll draft the public blurb. Quick ask: should we mention fallback to lower-capacity model and cache bypass? Also need exact affected endpoints and ETA for first update.
rowan: Affected: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Symptom: increased latency then 503 when queue depth >120. Mitigation: autoscaler warming; we enabled lower-tier fallback and increased worker pool in the region. No user data loss.
legal-scout: quick nudge on wording: avoid "no data loss" unless we are 100% sure. maybe use "no evidence of data loss at this time."
rowan: good call — update copy.
emma: Updated draft v2:
```
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent 503 errors affecting text generation and embeddings in the APAC region (apac-west-1). Some requests may fail or be slower than usual. Our team is actively scaling capacity and enabling fallbacks; no evidence of data loss at this time. Next update planned in 15 minutes.
```
sahil: L10n heads-up: we'll need JP/KO/FR translations. Can we publish EN first and append translations within the next update window? If so I'll queue localization.
rowan: yes publish EN first. callout for JP/KO later is fine.
release-eng: I can publish. Using statuspage API. command I'll run in ~10m:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.statuspage.io/v1/pages/<page_id>/incidents" \
 -H "Authorization: OAuth $PAGE_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"incident":{"name":"APAC: partial degradation of generation & embeddings","status":"investigating","body":"<paste draft v2 here>"}}'
```
release-eng: I'll also attach the internal incident link and mark as "investigating". please :thumbsup: if copy is good.
emma: :thumbsup: small tweak — replace "Some requests may fail" with "A subset of requests may fail" for clarity.
rowan: agreed with emma. update v3 applied.
emma: v3 final:
```
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent 503 errors affecting text generation and embeddings in the APAC region (apac-west-1). A subset of requests may fail or be slower than usual. Our engineers are scaling capacity and enabling fallback model variants to reduce impact. There is no evidence of data loss at this time. Next update in ~15 minutes.
```
opsbot: Mitigation event: autoscaler started new workers in apac-west-1. Error rate decreased ~40% in last 5m.
rowan: good signal. once posted I'll coordinate the oncall follow-up and schedule the 1h postmortem notes.
release-eng: Posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0423-A — Incident status: Investigating. Emma, please push the JP/KO/FR localization tasks to the l10n queue.
sahil: queued. ETA for translations ~20-30m.
opsbot: Update: observed 70% reduction in 5xx for targeted endpoints after worker scaling. Continuing monitoring. (automated metric alert cleared: gen-5xx-rate-apac)
rowan: thanks all. if signal stays good, we'll aim to resolve and publish resolved notice in the next 20-30m. keep reactions on the thread for quick ack.
release-eng: will stand by for resolved publish. :white_check_mark:
opsbot: Final: incident resolved. Autoscaler stable, fallbacks removed, 5xx rate back to baseline. Incident timeline and mitigations added to internal doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/INC-2026-0423-A
rowan: resolved — thanks team. emma please publish resolved notice with summary and customer impact. sahil please attach localized resolved copy when ready.
emma: Draft resolved notice:
```
Resolved — The increased latency and intermittent 503 errors affecting text generation and embeddings in APAC (apac-west-1) have been resolved. Root cause: temporary queue saturation during a spike in traffic; mitigations: autoscaler expansion and temporary fallback model routing. We are reviewing long-term fixes and will share a follow-up postmortem.
```
sahil: translated resolved notice pushed to queue.
rowan: closing oncall. postmortem owner: emma. timeline doc due EOD.
opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0423-A closed by rowan at 1765011200.
